data.about: Marketing management focuses on planning, pricing, promotion, and distribution to deliver value and achieve organizational goals. Consumer behaviour examines how individuals decide what to buy, influenced by psychological, social, and cultural factors. Together, they guide market research, segmentation, targeting, positioning, branding, and relationship building to satisfy customers, build loyalty, and drive sustainable business growth.

data.title: Data Structure and Algorithms
data.authors: Dr. Akheel Mohammed, Dr. Gurrampally Kumar, A.Swamy Goud, S.Anusha
data.about: Data structures organize and store data efficiently, while algorithms define step-by-step procedures to solve problems. Together, they enable optimized searching, sorting, processing, and memory management. Concepts like arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hashing, recursion, and dynamic programming improve performance, scalability, and reliability, forming the foundation of efficient software development and computational problem solving.

data.authors: Dr. Arun .A
data.about: Deep learning in computer vision uses neural networks, especially CNNs and transformers, to interpret images and videos. It enables tasks like image classification, object detection, segmentation, tracking, and generation. Applications span healthcare, security, autonomous vehicles, retail, and media, delivering accurate perception, automation, and insights beyond traditional image recognition.
